comment_regular:
Clamps an age/sex target pair, computes target-current deltas, couples them through the authored 2x2 transform, and adds two basis-transpose corrections to parameters.matrix[2*matrixChannel].

SetControlPair computes clampedTarget-current projection for two controls, multiplies deltas by cached 2x2 transform at this+0xC34+0x10*(channel+2*fan), then adds two scaled basis transposes to matrix[2*channel]. Uninitialized FanControls produces no update. Fan upper-bound assertion logs/returns; this entry has no direct channel guard.
